market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $90 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI $101-102 on May 4. Hitting $90 low needs ~11% drop within 27 days. Possible if Iran ceasefire firms or OPEC+ surprises supply, but elevated geopolitical premium argues against. Below 50%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Pace of Iran de-escalation and OPEC+ decisions
